summary: Portkey is a self-hosted web portal that functions as a customisable start page and link directory. It allows you to organise collections of URLs and build additional pages, with all content managed through a single configuration file.
goodFor: It suits anyone wanting a lightweight, self-hosted dashboard to centralise links and resources behind a single interface.
watchOut: Configuration relies entirely on manual edits to a single file rather than a graphical interface, and the project has a relatively small community compared to alternative dashboard solutions.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires persistent storage mounted for the configuration file and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
